lines: Ninja
「――You were arrogant, butler of Danjou! Did you think you could beat us with that wound?!!」
Amane
「Hmph. No matter what condition my body is in, I won't lose to the likes of you――」
Amane curved her lips.
She smoothly blocked the blade that was swung down at high speed, and then used the momentum from that to slam her opponent to the ground.
Ninja
「Guhah?!!」
Having had his cervical vertebrae broken, the ninja threw up bloody vomit.
It was a move known as Fuuma Martial Arts: Wave Style.
With this, she could fight without using any of her own power, while guarding her injured body.
Ninja
「Shit?! Retreat here for now!!!」
The wounded group disappeared from the scene, without persisting in the fight.
Amane
「Hmph. Just scouts after all, huh......?」
Amane purposely let them go.
The wound on her right foot was larger than she thought. Even if she chased after them, it likely wouldn't get results.
Amane
（Besides, in the first place, I――）
Amane
Suddenly, a stabbing pain in her abdomen.
It looked like there was a limit to how much she could disguise with martial arts.
The severe injuries that Amane had received from the enemies'―the ninjas'—leader were stab wounds which heavily punctured her right foot and her abdomen.
Blood seeped out from beneath the palm that covered her belly.
While twisting her face in pain, she slumped to her knees on the floor.
Kotarou
「――Amane-san?! A-Are you all right?!!」
Amane
「?! You――Didn't I tell you to stay hidden?!」
Kotarou came running in, making his face pale.
It seemed that he hadn't followed her order, and had been secretly watching Amane's fight.
Kotarou
「I-I'm sorry......! But, I was worried about Amane-san's wound......」
Amane
「.........You're a genuine idiot, aren't you? As if a ninja would be weakened by this little.」
She spat out――but that was just a bluff.
Amane's abdominal wound was deep, and was eating away at her life by the moment.
Kotarou
「A-And...... also, who were those guys just now......?」
Kotarou
「They're not Gosha Taimanin...... and I don't think they're like Fuuma ninja either......」
Amane
「They are Fuuma shinobi. Except――those are rogue ninja.」
Kotarou
Amane
「They're a group of rogue ex-Fuuma ninja, who defected to the UFS after Danjou-sama's death.」
Amane
「In other words, people with the same position and circumstances as me――birds of a feather, as it were.」
Kotarou
「The same as Amane-san......?」
After Fuuma Danjou's rebellion――

Most of the ninja who had been his followers had allied with Gosha along with Kotarou, the newly-appointed head of the family, but meanwhile, there were those who did not accept that, and continued to fight.
Amane was one of them, as were the group of people who had attacked her earlier. However――
Kotarou
「B-But, why did they attack Amane-san......?」
Amane
「It's because I tried to leave them and make it on my own. Fighting with those guys had become pointless.」
That was why her pursuers had been sicced on her.
To purge, and make an example of, the person who tried to leave the faction.
Kotarou
「Tried to leave......? Did something happen......?」
Amane
「Is it anything to do with you? Don't poke your nose in too deeply, idiot.」
Kotarou
The boy cast his eye downward like he was hurt.
Amane
（...............I'm the stupid one, aren't I?）
She knew he wasn't at fault.
And that there had been no other way for the defeated Fuuma clan to survive but to do that.

But for Amane, who idolized Danjou as her one and only master, it was difficult to think favourably of Kotarou, who had immediately surrendered to Gosha after his father's death, and Tokiko, who was serving as his guardian.
Amane
「.........More importantly, you go think of a good way to hide or something.」
Amane
「The guys before were only scouts. They'll come back soon with reinforcements.」
Kotarou
「Eh?」
He raised his face and looked at her.
Amane
「Their target is me. If they just take my head, they'll probably be satisfied and leave.」
Of course, Amane had no intention of being beaten, no matter how many small fries she was surrounded by.
However, “he” would definitely be coming next time.
The man who, after Danjou's death, had gathered what remained of his army, defected to the UFS, and become the leader of the Fuuma Rogue Ninja Faction.
Amane
（In truth, I wish I could have gotten you away from here, though......）
This matter was nothing to do with Kotarou.
She hadn't intended to drag him into it.
However, if they were to learn he was “Danjou's son”, they would probably not leave him be.
And, this mansion should already be surrounded by rogue ninja.
There was no way out.
If they were lucky, the shinobi would probably leave without noticing Kotarou's presence, but――
The moment Amane thought that far, the boy said, in an unexpectedly forceful voice,
Kotarou
「I-If that's the case, then――Please leave it to me, Amane-san! I have an idea!」
Amane
